files.description: Bike-share stations (48 rows, one per station): station_code (four-digit code with leading zeros, e.g. "0040"), station_name (text, a few with accented letters), district (same 6 districts as riders.csv; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), docks (whole number), opened_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD).

task_text: In stations.csv, clean district by trimming spaces and lower-casing, then number the six districts 0 to 5 in alphabetical order. `result` should be a Series of these district numbers indexed by station_code (text, leading zeros kept), in file order.
intended_computation: Read stations.csv keeping station_code as text; clean district (strip, lower case); code the six districts 0-5 in alphabetical order; a Series of these codes indexed by station_code in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: id columns (rider_id, station codes) may be written as integers without leading zeros
